name: What is the typical cost range for a whole home remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for a whole home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost for a whole home remodel varies widely based on factors such as the size of your home, the extent of structural changes, the quality of materials chosen, and finishes. A full renovation can range from $100-$300+ per square foot. For example, a 1,500 sq ft home could cost between $150,000 and $450,000 or more. This estimate includes labor, materials, permits, and contractor fees. A detailed proposal will be provided after an assessment of your specific project requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Whole home remodel costs typically range from $100-$300+ per square foot, varying by project scope and material choices.
